annotations.title: Register the bundle ID at Apple

description: For a new app: registers its iOS bundle ID with Apple (nothing happens if it's already there), so the person only picks it when creating the app in App Store Connect, which only a person can do there. Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
